title: Pet Insurance Premium Status Mix
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petinsurance:premium
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(payment_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the pet insurance premium feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `payment_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your pet insurance premium feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
